_comment: Copy to jarvis/bridge/config.json (git-ignored) and fill in email + password: a login on the ledger members list (best: its own, e.g. jarvis-mac@yourdomain). The Supabase URL and public key are read from ledger/config.js. 'scripts' are the ONLY extra commands Jarvis can run on this Mac — each 'run' is a list (program + arguments) run from the repo folder; 'background': true starts it and returns at once (for apps that keep running).
name: mac
